metadata.description: EnovaMotion is an AI creative platform providing AI image generation and AI video generation capabilities.
metadata.homeDescription: EnovaMotion is an AI creative platform supporting AI image generation and AI video generation. Start creating now.

home.heroDescription: EnovaMotion integrates AI image generation and AI video generation into a simple AI creative platform. Start creating now.
home.featuresSubtitle: All-in-one AI creative workstation, from inspiration to final output
home.featureImageDesc: Text-to-image, single image editing, and multi-image composition with multiple sizes. Results are automatically saved to object storage.
home.featureVideoDesc: Text-to-video, image-to-video, multi-image video, and keyframe animation with async task polling.
home.ctaDescription: Generate images or videos and experience EnovaMotion's AI creative capabilities.
home.footerDescription: EnovaMotion AI creative platform, providing integrated AI image generation and AI video generation capabilities.
